english.title: Overstay after excess charge for parking in contravention of a Local Traffic Order - outside Greater London

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: New Road and Street Works Act 1991

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ROAD AND LOCATION..), left that vehicle in a parking place, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PARKING PLACE..), designated by **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL TRAFFIC ORDER and NO..) for longer after the excess charge had been incurred than the time so authorised by the said order relating to the said parking place in that **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD BY WHICH THE PERMITTED STAY WAS EXCEEDED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to the above local traffic order and section 47(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in the case of an offence committed by a person in a street parking place reserved for disabled persons' vehicles where that person would not have been guilty of that offence if that motor vehicle in respect of which it was committed hand been a disabled person's vehicle.

A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale in any other case

Fixed penalty ticket - thirty pounds issued by Local Authority only NOT the Police

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months
